title: Certification dossier (Epic 3 story 9)
description: Machine-readable certification check inventory. Status vocabulary is closed: every check is either pass (collected on this Mac by scripts/check-certification-dossier.sh, which fails closed) or pending-owner (blocked on an owner-gated input named in missingInput; the script reports these and never fails on them).

schemaVersion.description: Must equal the schema file's dossierSchemaVersion.

dossierVersion.description: Version of this status file (v1 for the Epic 3 close).

generatedNote.description: How the file is maintained: by hand beside the script that verifies it.

evidence.description: Where the verdict comes from: a collector command, a source anchor, or a run artifact.

missingInput.description: REQUIRED on pending-owner: the exact owner-gated input (hardware run, release signing, real TCC prompt) blocking the check.
